summary.headline: Jana SFB Q1 FY27 PAT of INR155 crore with NIM at 7.5% and credit cost flat at 0.45%, while deposits stayed flat QoQ.
summary.overview: Management reported Q1 FY27 PAT of INR155 crore, with NIM recovering to 7.5% on a 50 bps YoY fall in cost of funds and lower interest reversals from unsecured stress. Credit cost held at 0.45%, same as Q4, and gross NPA fell to 2.24% with net NPA at 0.85% of gross loans and PCR at 62.4%. Deposits were flat QoQ as bulk deposits fell about 6%, while CASA grew 7.1% QoQ and 31% YoY. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of 19-21% gross loan growth, 23-25% deposit growth and PAT of 80%+ for the year.

financial_highlights.change: Backed up; management expects steady around this level
Down 60 bps YoY from Q1 FY26
Of which INR196 crore covered by guarantee program

segments.name: Secured book (affordable housing, micro LAP, MSME, vehicle, gold)
segments.commentary: Secured assets grew 29% YoY; secured share is 72.8%, with management targeting about 80% over time. Micro LAP shrank in Q1 due to a shift toward direct sourcing and is expected to turn positive in Q2.

segments.name: Unsecured (MFI)
segments.commentary: MFI book of INR10,240 crore, with FY27 growth targeted at 10-12% YoY. Around 79.8% of unsecured is under the CGMFU guarantee program; management expects INR65 crore of claims in Q3.

segments.name: Gold loans
segments.commentary: Book of INR2,678 crore, average LTV 64%, GNPA guided at around 0.5%. Management plans 50-75 more gold branches over the next two quarters.

segments.name: NBFC term loans
segments.commentary: Deliberately reduced by design; expected to stay flat through FY27 as own product lines grow 20-22%.

segments.name: Used car finance
segments.commentary: Launched October 2025; monthly disbursement about INR45 crore across roughly 50 cities.

guidance_outlook: FY27 gross loan growth guidance of 19-21% reiterated; deposit growth guidance of 23-25% reiterated; PAT of 80%+ for the year reiterated.
Cost of funds expected at around 7.4% (plus or minus 5 bps at best) for FY27; management says the opportunity to lower it further is over.
Credit cost to be at least 0.45% in each remaining quarter of FY27; provisioning expected flat to down.
Unsecured slippages expected flattish in Q2 and to drop modestly in Q3 and Q4.
Cost-to-income ratio to fall to about 63-65% during the year and not go below 60%; cost growth to stay very nominal.
CASA ratio target of about 20% for FY27.
Branch plan for FY27: 78 branches (8 new, 30 splits, 40 relocations); 7 executed so far.
Credit Line on UPI and loans against shares to go live in Q2 FY27; FCNR(B) not ready, possible small offering in Aug/Sep.
Management expects a first CGMFU recovery in Q3 FY27.
capex_capacity: Branch network at about 820 total branches, with 568-570 gold-loan branches; plans to add 50-75 gold branches over the next two quarters.
Branch plan for FY27: 78 total, comprising 8 new, 30 splits and 40 relocations; 7 executed as of the call.
Capital raise of INR728 crore: INR103 crore received, about INR80 crore due after TVS Group approval by RBI, and the balance over 18 months.
Nostro setup to begin in July to enable trade FX; FCNR(B) is not offered yet.
Used car finance present in about 50 cities, with a plan to consolidate the first 50 cities (about 70% of market) before expanding toward 240 cities.
demand_pricing: Deposit pricing hardened in April-May on tight liquidity; the bank raised deposit rates in June. Management expects cost of deposits to plateau at current levels.
Retail deposits are 64.9% of total, up from 60.2%; 97% of retail and 83% of bulk deposits are for tenors of one year and above.
Gold loan demand described as healthy; management sees no market issue despite recent gold price correction.
No material impact seen from the Iran conflict or El Nino so far; July collections visibility is limited as of July 15.
Government deposits (CASA-led) lost in Q4 have not returned; the bank is back on a state government empanelment list and expects some flow in Q2.

qa_highlights.question: What is the unsecured slippage trend and will improvement last?
qa_highlights.answer: Unsecured slippages fell about 20% QoQ, from INR155 crore to INR125 crore. Management expects Q2 slippage to be flattish to Q1, with small drops in Q3 and Q4, and a possible uptick in Q2 that recoveries should offset.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook for gold loan book amid gold price correction?
qa_highlights.answer: Average gold LTV is 64%, with daily price feeds and margin calls. GNPA is expected to stay around 0.5%, fully covered by collateral. The gold book grew 13.5% QoQ to INR2,678 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Explain the INR214 crore net NPA and INR196 crore guarantee cover on Slide 10, and claim timing.
qa_highlights.answer: Of the INR214 crore unsecured net NPA, INR196 crore is covered by the guarantee program, leaving an uncovered portion of about INR18 crore. Of INR196 crore, INR65 crore will be claimed in Q3, with the balance claimed subsequently.

qa_highlights.question: Is CASA growth of 7% QoQ sustainable and what is the FY27 CASA ratio target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 7% QoQ cannot be sustained every quarter; YoY CASA growth is about 31%. The CASA ratio target is about 20%, with CASA growth expected to exceed term deposit growth.

qa_highlights.question: Cost of funds and cost-to-income outlook.
qa_highlights.answer: Cost of funds to stay in a 7.3-7.4% range as bulk and retail growth and modest rate increases offset each other. Cost-to-income is 66.7-67% now and should move to 63-65% during the year, not below 60%.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of promoter (holding company) liquidity and rating downgrade.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no financial or operational impact, with no cross-default linkage, no common board members and no obligation on the bank to service promoter debt. The holding company holds 16.9%, down from a peak of 44%; CARE did not place the bank on watch.

risks_watch: Deposit franchise: flat QoQ deposits and about 6% bulk runoff against the 23-25% growth guidance, with H1 results expected to show progress.
MFI concentration at about 27% of the book; 79.8% of unsecured is guarantee-backed, and CGMFU claims timing (INR65 crore in Q3) matters.
Micro LAP declined in Q1 and NBFC book is shrinking by design; both need to turn positive to hit the 19-21% loan growth target.
Promoter-level stress: holding company and JCL rating downgraded by India Ratings after an NCD share-sale deadline extension; the bank says there is no direct impact.
Government deposit recovery is uncertain; the timing of flows from the state government is unclear.
Macro factors such as the Iran conflict, El Nino and gold price moves; management says no visible impact so far.
summary.management_tone: Confident and reassuring on asset quality, credit cost and the guarantee cover. Noticeably cautious on deposits and liquidity, with April-May described as difficult and growth recovery deferred to H1 results. Management was evasive on the merger rumour ("no comment on market speculation").
key_quotes: So one can expect that the 0.45% cost will at the minimum be maintained at the same levels in all the remaining quarters.
I think the opportunity to drop cost of funds is now over.
I do want to bring cost income back to much lower levels before the year is over.
We're at a good point now where we're doing 99%, plus or minus 0.1% since December.

adds.what: 78 branch plan for FY27 (8 new, 30 splits, 40 relocations); 7 executed so far
50-75 gold-loan branches over next two quarters (on ~820 branch base)

growth.why: Guides FY27 gross loan growth of 19-21% and deposit growth of 23-25%, with PAT of 80%+; backing is partial, citing a 78-branch plan (7 done), 50-75 new gold branches, the gold book up 100%+ YoY, and a secured-book shift, but no order-book or quantified capacity behind the loan growth.
